history.user: Just got to the hotel in Shinagawa. The conference badge has my name spelled wrong and I am too tired to care.
history.assistant: A long flight and a misspelled badge. Tired enough to let it go sounds about right.

history.user: Home again. The cat ignored me for an hour and then slept on my suitcase.
history.assistant: An hour of protest, then claiming the suitcase. Message received.

history.user: The last trick-or-treaters just left. We went through four bags of candy and I am sitting on the porch steps with the empty bowl.
history.assistant: Four bags gone and a quiet porch. That is a full Halloween.

history.user: It is past midnight now. My neighbor Odalys came over with cider and we are still out here talking.
history.assistant: Cider on the steps after midnight is a good way to let the night wind down.

history.user: She told me she is selling the house in the spring. I did not expect that to land as hard as it did.
history.assistant: That kind of news can arrive quietly and still knock something loose.

history.user: She has gone home. I am inside now, blowing out the pumpkins one at a time.
history.assistant: One at a time sounds like you are not quite ready for the night to be over.

history.user: Found one more piece of candy at the bottom of the bowl, a peanut butter cup, and ate it standing at the sink.
history.assistant: The last one always tastes like a small secret.

history.user: Still awake. I keep thinking about who will live next door after her.
history.assistant: It is hard to picture someone else behind that door.

history.user: Ha, the clocks just went back. The oven says quarter past one again, so apparently I get this hour twice.
history.assistant: A second pass at the same hour. Not everyone gets a do-over.

history.user: Okay, going to bed for real this time.

steps.text: What did I tell you on Halloween night before midnight, and what came after midnight?
Which did I mention first, the last piece of candy or the clocks changing?
And what day did I get to the hotel on that trip?
